narrative.northStar: Wand, with the cleanliness of Linear and Apple Notes
narrative.overview: The existing Wand double-cat identity on a white canvas, with restrained system typography and a black primary action. The user’s Linear / Apple Notes references establish cleanliness and brevity; no new visual identity is introduced.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet white surfaces and clear type hierarchy.
Short copy and visible installation actions.
dos: Do preserve the existing double-cat mark.
Do use placement, hierarchy and whitespace to explain the page.
Do keep release availability and recovery messages truthful.
donts: Don’t add slogans, secondary badges or decorative marketing copy.
Don’t present the terminal illustration as a real application screenshot.
Don’t introduce decorative gradients or repetitive feature cards.
